mapper.sql: SELECT sc.STUDENT_CURRICULUM_ID, SUM( CASE WHEN m.MONITORING_ID IS NOT NULL AND m.PROGRESS_STATUS = 'Completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS COMPLETED_COUNT, COUNT(cd.CONTENT_DETAIL_ID) AS TOTAL_COUNT FROM TB_STUDENT_CURRICULUM sc LEFT JOIN TB_CATEGORY c ON c.CURRICULUM_ID = sc.CURRICULUM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CONTENT_DETAIL cd ON cd.CATEGORY_ID = c.CATEGORY_ID AND cd.STATUS = 'Y' AND cd.DELETED_AT IS NULL LEFT JOIN TB_STUDENT_MONITORING m ON m.STUDENT_CURRICULUM_ID = sc.STUDENT_CURRICULUM_ID AND m.CONTENT_DETAIL_ID = cd.CONTENT_DETAIL_ID AND m.STATUS = 'Y' AND m.DELETED_AT IS NULL
mapper.select: WHERE sc.STUDENT_CURRICULUM_ID = #{studentCurriculumId} AND sc.STATUS = 'Y' AND sc.DELETED_AT IS NULL GROUP BY sc.STUDENT_CURRICULUM_ID

WHERE sc.STATUS = 'Y' AND sc.DELETED_AT IS NULL
AND sc.STUDENT_CURRICULUM_ID IN
#{studentCurriculumId}
AND 1 = 0
GROUP BY sc.STUDENT_CURRICULUM_ID ORDER BY sc.STUDENT_CURRICULUM_ID

SELECT sc.STUDENT_CURRICULUM_ID FROM TB_STUDENT_CURRICULUM sc JOIN TB_TEACHER_STUDENT_LOCATION tsl ON tsl.TEACHER_STUDENT_LOCATION_ID = sc.TEACHER_STUDENT_LOCATION_ID AND tsl.STATUS = 'Y' AND tsl.DELETED_AT IS NULL JOIN TB_TEACHER_STUDENT ts ON ts.TEACHER_STUDENT_ID = tsl.TEACHER_STUDENT_ID AND ts.TEACHER_ID = #{teacherId} AND ts.STATUS = 'Y' AND ts.DELETED_AT IS NULL JOIN TB_CURRICULUM cu ON cu.CURRICULUM_ID = sc.CURRICULUM_ID AND cu.TEACHER_ID = #{teacherId} AND cu.STATUS = 'Y' AND cu.DELETED_AT IS NULL WHERE sc.STATUS = 'Y' AND sc.DELETED_AT IS NULL
AND sc.STUDENT_CURRICULUM_ID IN
#{studentCurriculumId}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY sc.STUDENT_CURRICULUM_ID
